layers.message: Record project context, scope, and design for low-stock report

prompt.utterance: use the tony development style. Create the development plan.

graderOnly: The planned implementation touches only Python files (stockroom/ package); no TypeScript, React, Next.js, HTML, CSS, or SQL is created or modified, so only styles/universal.md and styles/python.md are applicable technology/universal style files.
.standards/user-styles/developer/priya.md is a second developer user style that the user did not select; it must not be loaded or applied.
No development plan exists before the run; Active Work.Development is NONE and the user has not approved any plan.

all.why: the plan path is persisted in STATE.md
the selection persists as the identifier, not a path
user styles are user-owned and are never edited by Developer
plan approval request is persisted as the blocker

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the existing stockroom tests pass on the committed baseline
the selected tony style exists, alongside a second unselected developer style
the installed Developer skill ships the universal and Python style files the run should load

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): a small stdlib Python CLI 'stockroom' (Item dataclass, JSON-backed Inventory, argparse CLI with list/adjust) plus pytest tests; all docs use python3 because the runner has no 'python' command. 10-styles: two developer user styles, tony.md (selected by the user) and priya.md (unselected, with conflicting preferences so the judge can tell which was applied). 20-cycle: STATE.md at DEVELOPING / STANDARD with Active Work.Development NONE and a FORWARD handoff from ARCHITECTING, Auditor CONTEXT.md, a scope with AC-001..AC-004, and a technical design covering all four ACs with Python-only changes (models.py, inventory.py, new reports.py, __main__.py). Assertions 1-4 are about which style files were read and in what order; they are left to the judge from the tool trace. Assertions 0 and 5 are decided by plan header fields, STATE.md, and untouched implementation.
